title: Water-Heater Relief-Valve Drip Pattern
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), water pressure (`waterpressure:reading`), irrigation control (`irrigation:zone`), water-heater events (`waterheater:event`), greywater tanks (`greywater:tank`), and utility sensors for pumps and softeners (`sumppump:event`, `wellpump:event`, `watersoftener:status`).
app: Water and plumbing telemetry from smart water meters, pressure sensors, irrigation controllers, sump and well pumps, greywater tanks, and water-heater sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=waterheater:event component="tpr_valve"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as drip_events by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts relief-valve drip events by day so pressure or overheating symptoms are visible before they become a safety problem.
value: Relief-valve drips are easy to ignore in the moment, but trend data turns them into a real maintenance signal.
implementation: Log drip sensor activations or manual maintenance observations near the temperature and pressure relief valve.
visualization: Daily trend line of relief-valve drip events.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how often the water heater's safety valve is dripping, which can point to pressure trouble before it gets serious.
